list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.description: Environment shown by the panels: its label in the series and its PostgreSQL data source.

panels.title: Definition of Done: LLM latency, queues, RPS
LLM call p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of provider call duration (run_actions, tool llm.call) over the dashboard range. On a conventions cache miss the conventions call is counted with the review calls: the call kind is not in the run_actions columns the Grafana role can read.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS "p95"
FROM run_actions
WHERE tool = 'llm.call' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Requests per second
panels.description: All requests through the edge proxy to the API and UI hosts. Includes the external probes: one request a minute per probed name.

panels.title: Messages waiting in review queues
panels.description: Ready messages in review.run.* and review.publish.

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Runs that finished as failed in the dashboard range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "failed"
FROM runs
WHERE state = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)

panels.title: LLM call latency
panels.description: Duration of every LLM provider call (run_actions, tool llm.call) in 5-minute buckets. On a conventions cache miss conventions and review calls are mixed: the call kind is not in the run_actions columns the Grafana role can read.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '5m'),
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS "p50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS "p95",
  max(duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS "max"
FROM run_actions
WHERE tool = 'llm.call' AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Requests per second by host
panels.description: Edge proxy request rate per host (Caddy metrics). Includes the external probes: one request a minute per probed name.

panels.title: Review queues: ready messages
panels.description: Messages waiting for a consumer per queue (SD §7.1): review.run.*, review.publish, retry queues and reviews.dlq.

panels.title: Review queues: in work and consumers
panels.description: Delivered but not yet acknowledged messages and attached consumers per review queue.

panels.title: Phase duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile per trace tool (docs/PIPELINE_SPEC.md §2): diff, context, LLM, post-processing, publication. llm.call mixes the conventions call (on a cache miss) and the review calls: the call kind is not in the run_actions columns the Grafana role can read. context.build is the context build from the diff, once per attempt since #168 part 6; attempts recorded before it also hold the read of the review prompt input, so a range across that deploy mixes the two steps.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '15m'),
  tool AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS value
FROM run_actions
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Phases over the range
panels.description: Calls and durations of each trace tool in the dashboard range. context.build is written once per attempt since #168 part 6 (the context build from the diff); an attempt recorded before it that reached the review also wrote the prompt input read, so its count is doubled there and its durations mix the two steps. llm.call counts the conventions call (on a cache miss) with the review calls.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  tool AS "Phase",
  count(*) AS "Calls",
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS "p50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS "p95",
  max(duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS "Max"
FROM run_actions
WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)
GROUP BY tool
ORDER BY "p95" DESC

panels.title: Finished runs per hour
panels.description: Runs by final state (docs/PIPELINE_SPEC.md §1).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at, '1h'),
  state::text AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(finished_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failed runs by error code
panels.description: error_code catalogue: docs/PIPELINE_SPEC.md §6.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  coalesce(error_code, '(none)') AS "Error code",
  count(*) AS "Runs",
  max(finished_at) AS "Last"
FROM runs
WHERE state = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(finished_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: LLM cost per hour
panels.description: Provider cost recorded in usage_events per model.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'),
  model AS metric,
  sum(cost_usd)::float8 AS value
FROM usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LLM spend this month
panels.description: Provider cost in usage_events since the 1st of the month (UTC), summed over the databases this Prometheus scrapes, and its share of LLM_MONTHLY_BUDGET_USD; the share turns orange and red where LlmMonthlyBudgetWarning and LlmMonthlyBudgetExceeded fire. Without a budget only the spend is shown.

panels.title: LLM tokens per hour
panels.description: Tokens recorded in usage_events.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h'),
  sum(tokens_in)::float8 AS "input",
  sum(tokens_out)::float8 AS "output",
  sum(cache_read_tokens)::float8 AS "cache read"
FROM usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 5xx share by host
panels.description: Share of 5xx responses; the alert ApiHigh5xxRate fires above 5%. Includes the external probes: one request a minute per probed name.

panels.title: Response time p95 by host
panels.description: 95th percentile of request duration at the edge proxy (SSE streams included). Includes the external probes: one request a minute per probed name.

panels.title: Host CPU
panels.description: Share of CPU time not idle on the VPS.

panels.title: Host memory
panels.description: Used = total minus available.

panels.title: Root filesystem used
panels.description: The alert HostDiskFull fires above 85%.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used per compose service (1 = one core): api, worker, webhook-worker, stores, monitoring.

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Working set per compose service.

panels.title: PostgreSQL connections
panels.description: Backends per database.

panels.title: Redis memory
panels.description: Cache memory against maxmemory (128 MB on staging, allkeys-lru).

panels.title: Redis hit ratio
panels.description: Cache hits of the context stage (AST facts, file trees).

panels.title: Last verified backup
panels.description: Age of the newest dump that passed the restore check; the alert PostgresBackupStale fires after 26 h.

panels.title: Last attempt
panels.description: 1 = the last backup attempt passed pg_dump and the restore check.

panels.title: Dumps kept
panels.description: Dumps in the backup directory on the host (retention 7 days).

panels.title: Last off-host copy
panels.description: Time since the last successful encrypted copy to the bucket (every 15 min, kept 30 days); empty when BACKUP_S3_* are not set. PostgresBackupOffsiteStale fires after 3 h.

panels.title: Dump size
panels.description: Size of the newest verified dump (pg_dump custom format, compressed).

panels.title: Public names: probe
panels.description: HTTPS probe of each probed name once a minute from the monitoring host: UP is a 2xx answer after redirects; the alert PublicEndpointDown fires after 5 min DOWN.

panels.title: Certificate expires in
panels.description: Days until the earliest certificate a probed name serves expires; the alerts TlsCertificateExpiresSoon and TlsCertificateExpiring fire below 14 and 3 days. A name with no TLS answer for 10 min drops out here and shows DOWN on the probe panel.

panels.title: SLA availability, month to date
panels.description: Share of the month so far (UTC) that each probed prod name was up, from the blackbox probes; the target is 99.5 %. Always prod: the Environment switch does not change it. Not coloured; the allowance panels carry the alert thresholds.

panels.title: Downtime budget left
panels.description: Seconds of downtime left in the allowance of 0.5 % of the month (223.2 min in a 31-day month) for each probed prod name; negative once it is spent. Always prod: the Environment switch does not change it.

panels.title: Downtime budget spent
panels.description: Share of the monthly downtime allowance spent by each probed prod name; the alerts SlaAvailabilityAtRisk and SlaAvailabilityBreached fire above 50 % and at 100 %. Always prod: the Environment switch does not change it.
